queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT t.telescregistry AS telescope, o.weathprofile AS weathprofile,
         AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_mod, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
),
b AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS baseline FROM g
)
SELECT g.weathprofile,
       AVG(g.avg_mod) AS mean_avg_modindex,
       AVG(g.avg_phase) AS mean_avg_phaseshift,
       AVG(g.avg_mod - b.baseline) AS mean_modindex_excess
FROM g CROSS JOIN b
WHERE g.avg_mod > b.baseline
GROUP BY g.weathprofile;
SELECT signalclass, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
FROM signals
GROUP BY signalclass
HAVING AVG(modindex) >= (SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals);
WITH group_avg AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(s.snrratio) AS avg_snr
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.weathprofile
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT weathprofile, AVG(avg_snr) AS base_snr
  FROM group_avg
  GROUP BY weathprofile
)
SELECT g.observstation, g.avg_snr - b.base_snr AS excess
FROM group_avg g
JOIN baseline b ON g.weathprofile = b.weathprofile
WHERE g.avg_snr > b.base_snr;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT modtype, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mi
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY modtype
),
kept AS (
  SELECT * FROM g WHERE avg_mi > (SELECT AVG(avg_mi) FROM g)
)
SELECT modtype, avg_mi - (SELECT AVG(avg_mi) FROM kept) AS amount_above_baseline
FROM kept;
